notes: DEMONSTRATION DATA ONLY. The organisation and every person below are fictional.
The organisation domain uses the reserved .example TLD (RFC 2606).

In a real deployment this is replaced by the organisation's own profile: protected domains, directory export (e.g. Entra ID), role mailboxes and its payment-verification procedures. Point ORG_PROFILE_PATH at that file.

verificationWorkflows.title: Supplier bank-detail change
steps: Hold the payment - do not change the supplier's bank details from this email.
Call the supplier on the phone number held in the vendor master file, not one in this email.
Record who confirmed the change, then get a second approver before updating vendor bank details.

verificationWorkflows.title: Executive or urgent payment request
steps: Do not make the transfer on the strength of this email.
Confirm with the requester in person or on their known internal extension.
Process the payment only through the normal approval workflow, with its usual approvers.

verificationWorkflows.title: Payroll / salary account change
steps: Do not update any salary account from an email request.
Ask the employee to submit the change through the HR self-service portal, or confirm it with them in person.

verificationWorkflows.title: Login or password request
steps: Do not open the link or enter your password.
Open the organisation's service yourself (bookmark or intranet), never from this email.
Report the email to the security team.
